description: This file defines the EmployeesViewList class, which extends ViewList and handles displaying a list view for the Employees module in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for pre-display setup, search form preparation, rendering the module title with breadcrumbs, processing search queries, and list view processing.

classes.name: EmployeesViewList
classes.description: A class extending ViewList that manages the display, search, and title rendering of the employee list view in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Initial setup before display, creating a ListViewSmarty object and configuring multi-select based on user permissions.

methods.name: prepareSearchForm
methods.description: Overrides parent method to initialize a custom EmployeesSearchForm for employee searches.

methods.name: getModuleTitle
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the module's title and breadcrumbs bar, including 'Create' links if user has permissions.

methods.name: listViewProcess
methods.description: Handles rendering the list view, including setup of the ListViewSmarty object and templates.

methods.name: processSearchForm
methods.description: Processes search form input and generates the appropriate WHERE clause for database querying.
